metadata.description:
Our team met this tribal singer in a small village of Khargone district. A science graduate, Champalal Badole belongs to a family of farmers. He writes songs about adivasi culture, identity and the hardships faced by the community. But his songs are also full of hope of a better future for the tribal population of the country.

#Madhya_Pradesh #Champalal_Badole #Tribal_Music
